Response Text:---
The `placePipe` method should convert the given row and column into a `Coordinate` object, then attempt to place the current pipe from the `pipeQueue` onto the map at that coordinate. If the placement is successful, it should update the `pipeQueue` by removing the placed pipe, update the `delayBar` (likely resetting or updating the delay), push the placed cell onto the `cellStack` for undo functionality, and increment the number of steps.

Here is a complete implementation of the `placePipe` method:

```java
public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
    // Convert column character to 1-based column index (assuming 'A' or 'a' corresponds to 1)
    int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
    Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);

    // Get the current pipe to place
    Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
    if (currentPipe == null) {
        return false; // No pipe to place
    }

    // Try to place the pipe on the map at the coordinate
    boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
    if (!placed) {
        return false; // Placement failed
    }

    // Update pipe queue by removing the placed pipe
    pipeQueue.poll();

    // Update delay bar (assuming a method to reset or update delay)
    delayBar.reset();

    // Push the placed cell onto the cell stack for undo
    Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
    if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
        cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
    }

    // Increment the number of steps
    numOfSteps++;

    return true;
}
```

This implementation assumes:
- `pipeQueue.peek()` returns the current pipe to place without removing it.
- `pipeQueue.poll()` removes the current pipe from the queue.
- `map.placePipe(Coordinate, Pipe)` attempts to place the pipe and returns a boolean indicating success.
- `delayBar.reset()` resets or updates the delay bar after placing a pipe.
- `map.getCell(Coordinate)` returns the cell at the coordinate.
- Only `FillableCell` instances are pushed onto the `cellStack`.
- `numOfSteps` is incremented after a successful placement.

    // Get the current pipe to place

    if (currentPipe == null) {
        return false; // No pipe to place
    }

	 *
```java
	 * @return {@code true} if the game is lost.

	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue(pipes);
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
		this.cellStack.clear();
	}
```

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe == null) {
```java
			return false;
		}
		boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
		if (!placed) {
			return false;
		}
		pipeQueue.poll();
		delayBar.reset();
		Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
			cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
		}
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}
```

	/**
	 * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
	 */
	public void skipPipe() {
```java
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
		if (currentPipe != null) {
			delayBar.reset();
			numOfSteps++;
		}
	}
```

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
```java
		lastCell.reset();
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}
}
```

```java
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current game state.
	 */
	public void display() {
		map.display();
		System.out.println();
		pipeQueue.display();
		cellStack.display();
		System.out.println();
		delayBar.display();
	}

	/**
	 * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
	 */
	public int getNumOfSteps() {
		// TODO
		return 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue(pipes);
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
		this.cellStack.clear();
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
		boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
		if (!placed) {
			return false;
		}
		pipeQueue.poll();
		delayBar.reset();
		Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
			cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
		}
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
	 */
	public void skipPipe() {
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
		if (currentPipe != null) {
			delayBar.reset();
			numOfSteps++;
		}
	}

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
		lastCell.reset();
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}

	public void updateState() {
		int distance = delayBar.getValue();
		map.fillTiles(distance);
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the game is won.
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is won.
	 */
	public boolean hasWon() {
		return map.hasWon();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the game is lost. <p> Hint: This method should invoke  {@link Map#hasLost()} . You may also need other judgements. </p>
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is lost.
	 */
	public boolean hasLost() {
		return map.hasLost();
	}
}
```

```java
	 * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.

	@NotNull

		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue(pipes);
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
		this.cellStack.clear();
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
		boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
		if (!placed) {
			return false;
		}
		pipeQueue.poll();
		delayBar.reset();
		Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
			cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
		}
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}

	/**

	 */
	public void skipPipe() {
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
		if (currentPipe != null) {
			delayBar.reset();
			numOfSteps++;
		}
	}

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
		lastCell.reset();
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}
```

Response Text:---
The errors occur because the methods named `Game` are not constructors but regular methods (they have a return type `void` implicitly because of the method syntax). In Java, constructors must not have a return type and must have the exact same name as the class. Your current code has methods named `Game` with a `void` return type, so the compiler does not recognize them as constructors.

To fix this, you need to convert these methods into proper constructors by removing the `void` return type.

Here is the corrected `Game` class with proper constructors:

```java
package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

    @NotNull
    private final Map map;
    @NotNull
    private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
    @NotNull
    private final DelayBar delayBar;
    @NotNull
    private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

    private int numOfSteps = 0;

    /**
     * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
     *
     * <p>
     * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
     * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
     * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
     * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
     * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
     * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
     */
    @NotNull
    static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
        var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

        return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
    }

    /**
     * Displays the current game state.
     */
    public void display() {
        map.display();
        System.out.println();
        pipeQueue.display();
        cellStack.display();
        System.out.println();
        delayBar.display();
    }

    /**
     * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
     */
    public int getNumOfSteps() {
        return numOfSteps;
    }

    // Proper constructor without return type
    public Game(int rows, int cols) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
    }

    // Proper constructor without return type
    public Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue(pipes);
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
        this.cellStack.clear();
    }

    public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
        int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
        Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
        if (currentPipe == null) {
            return false;
        }
        boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
        if (!placed) {
            return false;
        }
        pipeQueue.poll();
        delayBar.reset();
        Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
        if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
        }
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
     */
    public void skipPipe() {
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
        if (currentPipe != null) {
            delayBar.reset();
            numOfSteps++;
        }
    }

    public boolean undoStep() {
        if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
        lastCell.reset();
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    public void updateState() {
        int distance = delayBar.getValue();
        map.fillTiles(distance);
    }

    /**
     * Checks whether the game is won.
     * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is won.
     */
    public boolean hasWon() {
        return map.hasWon();
    }

    /**
     * Checks whether the game is lost. <p> Hint: This method should invoke  {@link Map#hasLost()} . You may also need other judgements. </p>
     * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is lost.
     */
    public boolean hasLost() {
        return map.hasLost();
    }
}
```

**Explanation:**  
- Removed `void` from the two `Game` methods so they become proper constructors.  
- This allows the compiler to recognize them as constructors and resolve the errors about undefined constructors.  
- Now, `new Game(...)` calls will work correctly, and your tests should pass without constructor-related compilation errors.

```java
package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

	@NotNull
	private final Map map;
	@NotNull
	private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
	@NotNull
	private final DelayBar delayBar;
	@NotNull
	private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

	private int numOfSteps = 0;

	/**
	 * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
	 * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
	 * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
	 * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current game state.
	 */
	public void display() {
		map.display();
		System.out.println();
		pipeQueue.display();
		cellStack.display();
		System.out.println();
		delayBar.display();
	}

	/**
	 * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
	 */
	public int getNumOfSteps() {
		// TODO
		return 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue(pipes);
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
		this.cellStack.clear();
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
		boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
		if (!placed) {
			return false;
		}
		pipeQueue.poll();
		delayBar.reset();
		Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
			cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
		}
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
	 */
	public void skipPipe() {
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
		if (currentPipe != null) {
			delayBar.reset();
			numOfSteps++;
		}
	}

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
		lastCell.reset();
		numOfSteps++;
		return true;
	}

	public void updateState() {
		int distance = delayBar.getValue();
		map.fillTiles(distance);
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the game is won.
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is won.
	 */
	public boolean hasWon() {
		return map.hasWon();
	}

	/**
	 * Checks whether the game is lost. <p> Hint: This method should invoke  {@link Map#hasLost()} . You may also need other judgements. </p>
	 * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is lost.
	 */
	public boolean hasLost() {
		return map.hasLost();
	}
}
```

package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

    @NotNull
    private final Map map;
    @NotNull
    private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
    @NotNull
    private final DelayBar delayBar;
    @NotNull
    private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

    private int numOfSteps = 0;

    /**
     * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
     *
     * <p>
     * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
     * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
     * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
     * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
     * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
     * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
     */
    @NotNull
    static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
        var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

        return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
    }

    /**
     * Displays the current game state.
     */
    public void display() {
        map.display();
        System.out.println();
        pipeQueue.display();
        cellStack.display();
        System.out.println();
        delayBar.display();
    }

    /**
     * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
     */
    public int getNumOfSteps() {
        return numOfSteps;
    }

    // Proper constructor without return type
    public Game(int rows, int cols) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar();
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
    }

    // Proper constructor without return type
    public Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2, cells);
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue(pipes);
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
        this.cellStack.clear();
    }

    public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
        int colIndex = Character.toUpperCase(col) - 'A' + 1;
        Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(row, colIndex);
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
        if (currentPipe == null) {
            return false;
        }
        boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
        if (!placed) {
            return false;
        }
        pipeQueue.poll();
        delayBar.reset();
        Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
        if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
        }
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
     */
    public void skipPipe() {
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
        if (currentPipe != null) {
            delayBar.reset();
            numOfSteps++;
        }
    }

    public boolean undoStep() {
        if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
        lastCell.reset();
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    public void updateState() {
        int distance = delayBar.getValue();
        map.fillTiles(distance);
    }

    /**
     * Checks whether the game is won.
     * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is won.
     */
    public boolean hasWon() {
        return map.hasWon();
    }

    /**
     * Checks whether the game is lost. <p> Hint: This method should invoke  {@link Map#hasLost()} . You may also need other judgements. </p>
     * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is lost.
     */
    public boolean hasLost() {
        return map.hasLost();
    }
}

```java
        boolean placed = map.placePipe(coord, currentPipe);
        if (!placed) {
            return false;
        }
        pipeQueue.poll();
        delayBar.reset();
        Cell placedCell = map.getCell(coord);
        if (placedCell instanceof FillableCell) {
            cellStack.push((FillableCell) placedCell);
        }
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Directly skips the current pipe and use the next pipe.
     */
    public void skipPipe() {
        Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.poll();
        if (currentPipe != null) {
            delayBar.reset();
            numOfSteps++;
        }
    }

    public boolean undoStep() {
        if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        FillableCell lastCell = cellStack.pop();
        lastCell.reset();
        numOfSteps++;
        return true;
    }

    public void updateState() {
        int distance = delayBar.getValue();
        map.fillTiles(distance);
    }

    /**
     * Checks whether the game is won.
     * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is won.
     */
    public boolean hasWon() {
        return map.hasWon();
    }

     * @return   {@code  true}  if the game is lost.
     */
    public boolean hasLost() {
        return map.hasLost();
    }
```

package game;

import game.pipes.Pipe;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

```java
import java.util.LinkedList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * Class encapsulating the pipe queue.
 */
class PipeQueue {

	/**
	 * Maximum number of pipes to display in the queue.
	 */
	private static final int MAX_GEN_LENGTH = 5;

	@NotNull
	private final LinkedList<Pipe> pipeQueue;

	/**
	 * Displays the current queue.
	 */
	void display() {
		System.out.print("Next Pipes:  ");
		for (var p : pipeQueue) {
			System.out.print(p.toSingleChar() + "    ");
		}
		System.out.println();
	}

	/**
	 * Generates a new pipe.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: Use {@link java.util.Random#nextInt(int)} to generate random numbers.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @return A new pipe.
	 */
	private static Pipe generateNewPipe() {
		// TODO
	}
```

```java
	void PipeQueue() {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>();
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}
```

```java
	void PipeQueue(List<Pipe> pipes) {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>(pipes);
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}
```

	Pipe peek() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes in the queue.");
		}
		return pipeQueue.getFirst();
```java
	}
```

	void consume() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes to consume.");
		}
		pipeQueue.removeFirst();
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

```java
	void undo(final Pipe pipe) {
```
```java
		pipeQueue.addFirst(pipe);
		if (pipeQueue.size() > MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.removeLast();
		}
	}
```
}

```java
package game;

import game.pipes.Pipe;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.LinkedList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * Class encapsulating the pipe queue.
 */
class PipeQueue {

	/**
	 * Maximum number of pipes to display in the queue.
	 */
	private static final int MAX_GEN_LENGTH = 5;

	@NotNull
	private final LinkedList<Pipe> pipeQueue;

	/**
	 * Displays the current queue.
	 */
	void display() {
		System.out.print("Next Pipes:  ");
		for (var p : pipeQueue) {
			System.out.print(p.toSingleChar() + "    ");
		}
		System.out.println();
	}

	/**
	 * Generates a new pipe.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: Use {@link java.util.Random#nextInt(int)} to generate random numbers.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @return A new pipe.
	 */
	private static Pipe generateNewPipe() {
		// TODO
	}

	void PipeQueue() {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>();
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

	void PipeQueue(List<Pipe> pipes) {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>(pipes);
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

	Pipe peek() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes in the queue.");
		}
		return pipeQueue.getFirst();
	}

	void consume() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes to consume.");
		}
		pipeQueue.removeFirst();
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}
```

	void undo(final Pipe pipe) {
		pipeQueue.addFirst(pipe);
		if (pipeQueue.size() > MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.removeLast();
		}
```java
	}
```
```java
}
```

```java
package game;

import game.pipes.Pipe;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.LinkedList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;

/**
 * Class encapsulating the pipe queue.
 */
class PipeQueue {

	/**
	 * Maximum number of pipes to display in the queue.
	 */
	private static final int MAX_GEN_LENGTH = 5;

	@NotNull
	private final LinkedList<Pipe> pipeQueue;

	/**
	 * Displays the current queue.
	 */
	void display() {
		System.out.print("Next Pipes:  ");
		for (var p : pipeQueue) {
			System.out.print(p.toSingleChar() + "    ");
		}
		System.out.println();
	}

	/**
	 * Generates a new pipe.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * Hint: Use {@link java.util.Random#nextInt(int)} to generate random numbers.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @return A new pipe.
	 */
	private static Pipe generateNewPipe() {
		// TODO
	}

	void PipeQueue() {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>();
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

	void PipeQueue(List<Pipe> pipes) {
		pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>(pipes);
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

	Pipe peek() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes in the queue.");
		}
		return pipeQueue.getFirst();
	}

	void consume() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes to consume.");
		}
		pipeQueue.removeFirst();
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

	void undo(final Pipe pipe) {
		pipeQueue.addFirst(pipe);
		if (pipeQueue.size() > MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.removeLast();
		}
	}
}
```

```java
public Map(int rows, int cols) {
    if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must be at least 3x3 in size.");
    }

    this.rows = rows;
    this.cols = cols;
    this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];

    // Fill edges with walls and inner cells with empty FillableCells
    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
                cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
            } else {
                cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
            }
        }
    }

    // Generate source cell info (non-edge cell)
    TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
    Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;

    // Place source cell
    sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
    cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;

    // Generate sink cell info (edge cell)
    TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
    do {
        sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
        // Ensure sink cell does not overlap source cell
    } while (sinkInfo.coord.equals(sourceCoord));

    Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
    Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;

    // Place sink cell
    sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
    cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
}
```

**Explanation:**

- Checks minimum size (3x3) to ensure there is room for edges and inner cells.
- Initializes the `cells` array.
- Places `Wall` cells on the edges.
- Places `FillableCell` inside.
- Uses `generateStartCellInfo()` to get a valid source cell coordinate and direction.
- Places a `TerminationCell` as source at that coordinate.
- Uses `generateEndCellInfo()` to get a valid sink cell coordinate and direction, ensuring it does not overlap with source.
- Places a `TerminationCell` as sink at that coordinate.

This satisfies the requirements:
- One source tile in a non-edge cell.
- One sink tile in an edge cell.
- Source does not point into a wall (guaranteed by `generateStartCellInfo()`).
- Sink points outside the map (guaranteed by `generateEndCellInfo()`).
- Walls on edges.
- Other cells empty fillable cells.

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

			System.out.println();
		}

	}
```

```java
public Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
    if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must be at least 3x3 in size.");
    }
    if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array row count mismatch.");
    }
    for (Cell[] row : cells) {
        if (row == null || row.length != cols) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array column count mismatch.");
        }
    }

    this.rows = rows;
    this.cols = cols;
    this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];

    TerminationCell foundSource = null;
    TerminationCell foundSink = null;

    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            Cell cell = cells[r][c];
            if (cell == null) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null.");
            }
            this.cells[r][c] = cell;

            if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
                Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);
                Direction dir = tc.getDirection();

                boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
                if (tc.isSource()) {
                    // Source must be in non-edge cell
                    if (isEdge) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source tile must be in a non-edge cell.");
                    }
                    if (foundSource != null) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source tiles found.");
                    }
                    // Source must not point into a wall
                    Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(dir.getOffset());
                    if (!isInBounds(adjacent)) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source tile points outside the map.");
                    }
                    Cell adjacentCell = cells[adjacent.row][adjacent.col];
                    if (adjacentCell instanceof Wall) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source tile points into a wall.");
                    }
                    foundSource = tc;
                } else {
                    // Sink must be in edge cell
                    if (!isEdge) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink tile must be in an edge cell.");
                    }
                    if (foundSink != null) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink tiles found.");
                    }
                    // Sink must point outside the map
                    Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(dir.getOffset());
                    if (isInBounds(adjacent)) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink tile must point outside the map.");
                    }
                    foundSink = tc;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (foundSource == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source tile found.");
    }
    if (foundSink == null) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink tile found.");
    }

    this.sourceCell = foundSource;
    this.sinkCell = foundSink;
}

private boolean isInBounds(Coordinate coord) {
    return coord.row >= 0 && coord.row < rows && coord.col >= 0 && coord.col < cols;
}
```

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must be at least 3x3 in size.");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
		do {
			sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		} while (sinkInfo.coord.equals(sourceCoord));
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}
}
```

```java
boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
    // Convert one-based to zero-based indices
    int zeroBasedRow = row - 1;
    int zeroBasedCol = col - 1;

    // Check bounds
    if (zeroBasedRow < 0 || zeroBasedRow >= rows || zeroBasedCol < 0 || zeroBasedCol >= cols) {
        return false;
    }

    Cell cell = cells[zeroBasedRow][zeroBasedCol];

    // Check if cell is a FillableCell and does not already have a pipe
    if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
        if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
            fillableCell.setPipe(p);
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}
```

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must be at least 3x3 in size.");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
		do {
			sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		} while (sinkInfo.coord.equals(sourceCoord));
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must be at least 3x3 in size.");
		}
		if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array row count mismatch.");
		}
		for (Cell[] row : cells) {
			if (row == null || row.length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array column count mismatch.");
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				if (cell == null) {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null.");
				}
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);
					Direction dir = tc.getDirection();
					boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source tile must be in a non-edge cell.");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source tiles found.");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(dir.getOffset());
						if (!isInBounds(adjacent)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source tile points outside the map.");
						}
						Cell adjacentCell = cells[adjacent.row][adjacent.col];
						if (adjacentCell instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source tile points into a wall.");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (!isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink tile must be in an edge cell.");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink tiles found.");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isInBounds(adjacent)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink tile must point outside the map.");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source tile found.");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink tile found.");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}
}
```

Response Text:---
The `fillTiles` method should fill all fillable cells (pipes) within a given Manhattan distance from the `sourceCell`. A good approach is to perform a breadth-first search (BFS) starting from the source cell, expanding outward up to the specified distance, and marking fillable cells as filled.

Here is a complete implementation of `fillTiles` using BFS:

```java
public void fillTiles(int distance) {
    if (distance < 0 || sourceCell == null) {
        return;
    }

    filledTiles.clear();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    Map<Coordinate, Integer> distMap = new HashMap<>();

    Coordinate start = sourceCell.getCoord();
    queue.add(start);
    distMap.put(start, 0);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int currentDist = distMap.get(current);

        if (currentDist > distance) {
            continue;
        }

        Cell cell = cells[current.row][current.col];
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
            fillableCell.setFilled();
            filledTiles.add(current);
        } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
            terminationCell.setFilled();
            filledTiles.add(current);
        }

        if (currentDist == distance) {
            continue;
        }

        // Explore neighbors in 4 directions
        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
            if (!isInBounds(neighbor)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (distMap.containsKey(neighbor)) {
                continue;
            }
            Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
            // Only consider fillable cells, termination cells, or pipes (not walls)
            if (neighborCell instanceof Wall) {
                continue;
            }
            distMap.put(neighbor, currentDist + 1);
            queue.add(neighbor);
        }
    }
}
```

**Explanation:**

- We use a queue for BFS starting from the source cell coordinate.
- We keep track of the distance from the source for each cell.
- For each cell within the distance, if it is fillable or a termination cell, we mark it as filled and add its coordinate to `filledTiles`.
- We skip walls and cells outside the map.
- We stop expanding neighbors once the distance limit is reached.

This ensures all cells within the given distance from the source are filled correctly.

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {

			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	/**
	 * Undoes a step from the map. <p> Effectively replaces the cell with an empty cell in the coordinate specified. </p>
	 * @param coord  Coordinate to reset.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException  if the cell is not an instance of  {@link FillableCell} .
	 */
	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		if (!isInBounds(coord)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Coordinate is out of map bounds.");
		}
		Cell cell = cells[coord.row][coord.col];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at " + coord + " is not a FillableCell.");
		}
		cells[coord.row][coord.col] = new FillableCell(coord);
	}
```

public void fillTiles(int distance) {

        return;

    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    Map<Coordinate, Integer> distMap = new HashMap<>();

    Coordinate start = sourceCell.getCoord();
    queue.add(start);
    distMap.put(start, 0);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        int currentDist = distMap.get(current);

        if (currentDist > distance) {
            continue;

            filledTiles.add(current);

            terminationCell.setFilled();

Response Text:---
The method `checkPath` should verify if there is a valid path from the `sourceCell` to the `sinkCell` by traversing through connected pipes and cells. A Breadth-First Search (BFS) is a suitable approach here: start from the source cell, explore all reachable neighbors that are connected via pipes, and check if the sink cell is reached.

Key points:
- Only traverse cells that are connected via pipes (or are termination cells).
- Use the pipe connections and directions to verify connectivity between adjacent cells.
- Return true if the sink cell is reachable, false otherwise.

Here is a complete implementation of `checkPath` using BFS:

```java
public boolean checkPath() {
    if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
        return false;
    }

    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    queue.add(sourceCell.getCoord());
    visited.add(sourceCell.getCoord());

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();
        if (current.equals(sinkCell.getCoord())) {
            return true;
        }

        Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];
        if (!(currentCell instanceof FillableCell || currentCell instanceof TerminationCell)) {
            continue;
        }

        Pipe currentPipe = null;
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
            currentPipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
            if (currentPipe == null) {
                continue; // no pipe, cannot proceed
            }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            // TerminationCell is considered connected in its direction
            // We treat it as having a pipe that connects in its direction
            // For simplicity, we can consider it connected in all directions or just the direction it points to
            // Here, we treat it as connected in all directions to allow BFS to proceed
            currentPipe = null; // special case handled below
        }

        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(dir.getOffset());
            if (!isInBounds(neighborCoord) || visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                continue;
            }

            Cell neighborCell = cells[neighborCoord.row][neighborCoord.col];
            if (!(neighborCell instanceof FillableCell || neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell)) {
                continue;
            }

            Pipe neighborPipe = null;
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell fillableNeighbor) {
                neighborPipe = fillableNeighbor.getPipe();
                if (neighborPipe == null) {
                    continue; // no pipe, cannot proceed
                }
            } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                // same as above, treat as connected
                neighborPipe = null;
            }

            // Check if current cell's pipe connects to neighbor in direction dir
            boolean currentConnects = false;
            if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                // TerminationCell connects only in its direction
                TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) currentCell;
                if (tc.getDirection() == dir) {
                    currentConnects = true;
                }
            } else if (currentPipe != null) {
                currentConnects = currentPipe.connectsTo(dir);
            }

            // Check if neighbor cell's pipe connects back to current cell (opposite direction)
            boolean neighborConnects = false;
            Direction opposite = dir.getOpposite();
            if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                if (tc.getDirection() == opposite) {
                    neighborConnects = true;
                }
            } else if (neighborPipe != null) {
                neighborConnects = neighborPipe.connectsTo(opposite);
            }

            if (currentConnects && neighborConnects) {
                visited.add(neighborCoord);
                queue.add(neighborCoord);
            }
        }
    }

    return false;
}
```

**Explanation:**

- Start BFS from the source cell coordinate.
- For each cell, check all four directions.
- Verify that the current cell's pipe connects in that direction.
- Verify that the neighbor cell's pipe connects back in the opposite direction.
- If both connect, add neighbor to the queue.
- If sink cell is reached, return true.
- If BFS ends without reaching sink, return false.

This ensures that only properly connected pipes form the path.

```java
	/**
	 * Constructs a map from a map string.

	/**
	 * Tries to place a pipe at (row, col).
	 *
	 * @param coord Coordinate to place pipe at.
	 * @param pipe  Pipe to place in cell.
	 * @return {@code true} if the pipe is placed in the cell, {@code false} otherwise.

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must be at least 3x3 in size.");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
		do {
			sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		} while (sinkInfo.coord.equals(sourceCoord));
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must be at least 3x3 in size.");
		}
		if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array row count mismatch.");
		}
		for (Cell[] row : cells) {
			if (row == null || row.length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array column count mismatch.");
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				if (cell == null) {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null.");
				}
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);
					Direction dir = tc.getDirection();
					boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source tile must be in a non-edge cell.");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source tiles found.");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(dir.getOffset());
						if (!isInBounds(adjacent)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source tile points outside the map.");
						}
						Cell adjacentCell = cells[adjacent.row][adjacent.col];
						if (adjacentCell instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source tile points into a wall.");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (!isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink tile must be in an edge cell.");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink tiles found.");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isInBounds(adjacent)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink tile must point outside the map.");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source tile found.");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink tile found.");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int zeroBasedRow = row - 1;
		int zeroBasedCol = col - 1;
		if (zeroBasedRow < 0 || zeroBasedRow >= rows || zeroBasedCol < 0 || zeroBasedCol >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = cells[zeroBasedRow][zeroBasedCol];
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
			if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
				fillableCell.setPipe(p);
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	/**
	 * Undoes a step from the map. <p> Effectively replaces the cell with an empty cell in the coordinate specified. </p>
	 * @param coord  Coordinate to reset.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException  if the cell is not an instance of  {@link FillableCell} .
	 */
	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		if (!isInBounds(coord)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Coordinate is out of map bounds.");
		}
		Cell cell = cells[coord.row][coord.col];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at " + coord + " is not a FillableCell.");
		}
		cells[coord.row][coord.col] = new FillableCell(coord);
	}

	public void fillTiles(int distance) {
		if (distance < 0 || sourceCell == null) {
			return;
		}
		filledTiles.clear();
		Queue<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
		Map<Coordinate, Integer> distMap = new HashMap<>();
		Coordinate start = sourceCell.getCoord();
		queue.add(start);
		distMap.put(start, 0);
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate current = queue.poll();
			int currentDist = distMap.get(current);
			if (currentDist > distance) {
				continue;
			}
			Cell cell = cells[current.row][current.col];
			if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
				fillableCell.setFilled();
				filledTiles.add(current);
			} else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
				terminationCell.setFilled();
				filledTiles.add(current);
			}
			if (currentDist == distance) {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (!isInBounds(neighbor)) {
					continue;
				}
				if (distMap.containsKey(neighbor)) {
					continue;
				}
				Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
				if (neighborCell instanceof Wall) {
					continue;
				}
				distMap.put(neighbor, currentDist + 1);
				queue.add(neighbor);
			}
		}
	}
}
```

The method `hasLost` should return `true` if no new pipes were filled during the last round. The class `Map` tracks filled tiles in the `filledTiles` set and the count of previously filled tiles in `prevFilledTiles`. If after a round the number of filled tiles has not increased compared to `prevFilledTiles`, it means no new pipes were filled, and the game is lost.

A correct implementation updates `prevFilledTiles` to the current size of `filledTiles` and returns whether the size did not increase.

Here is a complete implementation of the `hasLost` method:

```java
/**
 * <p>
 * Hint: The game is lost when a round ends and no pipes are filled during the round. Is
 * there a way to check whether pipes are filled during a round?
 * </p>
 *
 * @return {@code true} if the game is lost.
 */
public boolean hasLost() {
    int currentFilled = filledTiles.size();
    boolean lost = currentFilled == prevFilledTiles;
    prevFilledTiles = currentFilled;
    return lost;
}
```

This method compares the current number of filled tiles with the previous count and updates the previous count for the next round. If no new tiles were filled (`currentFilled == prevFilledTiles`), the game is lost.

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {

			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must be at least 3x3 in size.");
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
					cells[r][c] = new Wall(new Coordinate(r, c));
				} else {
					cells[r][c] = new FillableCell(new Coordinate(r, c));
				}
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		Coordinate sourceCoord = sourceInfo.coord;
		Direction sourceDir = sourceInfo.direction;
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceCoord, sourceDir, true);
		cells[sourceCoord.row][sourceCoord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo;
		do {
			sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		} while (sinkInfo.coord.equals(sourceCoord));
		Coordinate sinkCoord = sinkInfo.coord;
		Direction sinkDir = sinkInfo.direction;
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkCoord, sinkDir, false);
		cells[sinkCoord.row][sinkCoord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		if (rows < 3 || cols < 3) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must be at least 3x3 in size.");
		}
		if (cells == null || cells.length != rows) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array row count mismatch.");
		}
		for (Cell[] row : cells) {
			if (row == null || row.length != cols) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cells array column count mismatch.");
			}
		}
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = cells[r][c];
				if (cell == null) {
					throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at (" + r + "," + c + ") is null.");
				}
				this.cells[r][c] = cell;
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell tc) {
					Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);
					Direction dir = tc.getDirection();
					boolean isEdge = (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1);
					if (tc.isSource()) {
						if (isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source tile must be in a non-edge cell.");
						}
						if (foundSource != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple source tiles found.");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(dir.getOffset());
						if (!isInBounds(adjacent)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source tile points outside the map.");
						}
						Cell adjacentCell = cells[adjacent.row][adjacent.col];
						if (adjacentCell instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source tile points into a wall.");
						}
						foundSource = tc;
					} else {
						if (!isEdge) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink tile must be in an edge cell.");
						}
						if (foundSink != null) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple sink tiles found.");
						}
						Coordinate adjacent = coord.add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isInBounds(adjacent)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink tile must point outside the map.");
						}
						foundSink = tc;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (foundSource == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No source tile found.");
		}
		if (foundSink == null) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No sink tile found.");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int zeroBasedRow = row - 1;
		int zeroBasedCol = col - 1;
		if (zeroBasedRow < 0 || zeroBasedRow >= rows || zeroBasedCol < 0 || zeroBasedCol >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = cells[zeroBasedRow][zeroBasedCol];
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
			if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
				fillableCell.setPipe(p);
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	/**
	 * Undoes a step from the map. <p> Effectively replaces the cell with an empty cell in the coordinate specified. </p>
	 * @param coord  Coordinate to reset.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException  if the cell is not an instance of  {@link FillableCell} .
	 */
	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		if (!isInBounds(coord)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Coordinate is out of map bounds.");
		}
		Cell cell = cells[coord.row][coord.col];
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell at " + coord + " is not a FillableCell.");
		}
		cells[coord.row][coord.col] = new FillableCell(coord);
	}

	public void fillTiles(int distance) {
		if (distance < 0 || sourceCell == null) {
			return;
		}
		filledTiles.clear();
		Queue<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
		Map<Coordinate, Integer> distMap = new HashMap<>();
		Coordinate start = sourceCell.getCoord();
		queue.add(start);
		distMap.put(start, 0);
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate current = queue.poll();
			int currentDist = distMap.get(current);
			if (currentDist > distance) {
				continue;
			}
			Cell cell = cells[current.row][current.col];
			if (cell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
				fillableCell.setFilled();
				filledTiles.add(current);
			} else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell terminationCell) {
				terminationCell.setFilled();
				filledTiles.add(current);
			}
			if (currentDist == distance) {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (!isInBounds(neighbor)) {
					continue;
				}
				if (distMap.containsKey(neighbor)) {
					continue;
				}
				Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
				if (neighborCell instanceof Wall) {
					continue;
				}
				distMap.put(neighbor, currentDist + 1);
				queue.add(neighbor);
			}
		}
	}

	public boolean checkPath() {
		if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
			return false;
		}
		Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
		Queue<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
		queue.add(sourceCell.getCoord());
		visited.add(sourceCell.getCoord());
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate current = queue.poll();
			if (current.equals(sinkCell.getCoord())) {
				return true;
			}
			Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];
			if (!(currentCell instanceof FillableCell || currentCell instanceof TerminationCell)) {
				continue;
			}
			Pipe currentPipe = null;
			if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell fillableCell) {
				currentPipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
				if (currentPipe == null) {
					continue;
				}
			} else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
				currentPipe = null;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (!isInBounds(neighborCoord) || visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
					continue;
				}
				Cell neighborCell = cells[neighborCoord.row][neighborCoord.col];
				if (!(neighborCell instanceof FillableCell || neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell)) {
					continue;
				}
				Pipe neighborPipe = null;
				if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell fillableNeighbor) {
					neighborPipe = fillableNeighbor.getPipe();
					if (neighborPipe == null) {
						continue;
					}
				} else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
					neighborPipe = null;
				}
				boolean currentConnects = false;
				if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
					TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) currentCell;
					if (tc.getDirection() == dir) {
						currentConnects = true;
					}
				} else if (currentPipe != null) {
					currentConnects = currentPipe.connectsTo(dir);
				}
				boolean neighborConnects = false;
				Direction opposite = dir.getOpposite();
				if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
					TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
					if (tc.getDirection() == opposite) {
						neighborConnects = true;
					}
				} else if (neighborPipe != null) {
					neighborConnects = neighborPipe.connectsTo(opposite);
				}
				if (currentConnects && neighborConnects) {
					visited.add(neighborCoord);
					queue.add(neighborCoord);
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
}
```

```java
package game.map;

import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.map.cells.TerminationCell;
import game.map.cells.Wall;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;
import util.StringUtils;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Map of the game.
 */
public class Map {

	private final int rows;
	private final int cols;
	@NotNull
	final Cell[][] cells;

	private TerminationCell sourceCell;
	private TerminationCell sinkCell;

	@NotNull
	private final Set<Coordinate> filledTiles = new HashSet<>();
	private int prevFilledTiles = 0;
	private Integer prevFilledDistance;

	/**
	 * Constructs a map from a map string.
	 * <p>
	 * This is a convenience method for unit testing.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows     Number of rows.
	 * @param cols     Number of columns.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @return A map with the cells set from {@code cellsRep}.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the map is incorrectly formatted.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Map fromString(int rows, int cols, @NotNull String cellsRep) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Map(rows, cols, cells);
	}

	/**
	 * Tries to place a pipe at (row, col).
	 *
	 * @param coord Coordinate to place pipe at.
	 * @param pipe  Pipe to place in cell.
	 * @return {@code true} if the pipe is placed in the cell, {@code false} otherwise.
	 */
	public boolean tryPlacePipe(@NotNull final Coordinate coord, @NotNull final Pipe pipe) {
		return tryPlacePipe(coord.row, coord.col, pipe);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current map.
	 */
	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void fillBeginTile() {
		sourceCell.setFilled();
	}

	@NotNull
	private List<Coordinate> getTraversedCoords() {
		return new ArrayList<>(filledTiles);
	}

	public boolean hasLost() {
```
